attributes.action: Car parking for The Word in South Shields
attributes.additional_details: The Word is frequented by many, especially  disabled. They attend the library,classes, talks, exhibitions and cafe. It is a lifeline for many who make and meet friends there. The parking opposite is to be closed for three months till Feburary 24th so it will be very difficult to get and if disabled practically impossibe. As disabled myself I know the 1600+ steps from the nearest carpark are beyond me. I have no-one to push my wheelchair. The empty market place could be used when no market is on.
